description: Store a memory. All memories start in Buffer and promote to Working/Core through access frequency and LLM quality gating. Procedural memories and lessons (tag=lesson) auto-promote to Working after 2h. Use supersedes to replace outdated memories by their ids.

kind.description: Memory type: semantic (facts, default), episodic (events), procedural (how-to, persists indefinitely)

namespace.description: Override namespace. Use "default" for cross-project knowledge (user identity, preferences, universal lessons)

supersedes.description: IDs of old memories this one replaces

sync_embed.description: Wait for embedding generation before returning (default: false)

name: engram_store
